title: Fix robust PDF/ZIP generation without CDN globals + better generation error reporting

requirements.summary: Bundle jsPDF and JSZip with the app (no CDN globals) so PDF/ZIP generation works reliably in production.
acceptanceCriteria: Generating a single product succeeds without requiring jsPDF/JSZip to exist on `window`.
Generating all 3 products succeeds in production and routes the user to the Export screen with 3 generated bundles.
No runtime error occurs due to `window.jspdf` or `window.JSZip` being undefined.

file_operations.description: Remove CDN script tags that provide global jsPDF/JSZip variables so production builds do not rely on window globals.
Ensure `jspdf` and `jszip` are declared as runtime dependencies (and any needed types) so they are bundled and available in production builds.
Add a small loader/wrapper that imports jsPDF from installed dependencies (no `window` usage) and exposes a stable API for PDF generation.
Add a small loader/wrapper that imports JSZip from installed dependencies (no `window` usage) and exposes a stable API for ZIP creation.
Replace `window.jspdf` access with the new jsPDF wrapper import so PDF generation works in production builds without global variables.
Replace `window.JSZip` access with the new JSZip wrapper import so per-product ZIP generation works without global variables.
Replace `window.JSZip` access with the new JSZip wrapper import so master ZIP generation works without global variables.

requirements.summary: Show clear, English root-cause generation errors in the editor UI with step (cover/PDF/ZIP) and product context, while logging full error details to console.
acceptanceCriteria: If generation fails, the editor screen shows an error message that includes the failing step (cover/PDF/ZIP) and the product number or product name.
Console logs include the original error object/stack for troubleshooting.
User-facing error text remains clear and English-only (no raw stack traces shown to users in production).

file_operations.description: Define a typed generation error model (including step: cover/PDF/ZIP, product id/name/number, and original cause) to preserve root-cause details without exposing stacks to users.
Add a helper to format generation errors into clear, English-only user messages (step + product context) while allowing full console logging separately.

Wrap failures from cover fetch, PDF generation, and ZIP generation into the typed generation error (including product context) and ensure console logs include the original error object/stack for troubleshooting.

When generating all products, propagate the first failure as a typed generation error that includes which product failed and at which step (cover/PDF/ZIP), preserving the original cause for console logging.
Update editor-screen error handling to display the formatted (English-only) root-cause message including step + product name/number, while logging the full original error/cause to the console.
